mobbin:e8c931f2-dc00-4c3f-9b4f-50b11564a.summary: Admin opens Dashboards, creates a named private dashboard with viewers and editors, then lands on an empty two-column work area beside a searchable Add a Gadget library of 31 items.
steps: Dashboards list with Default dashboard and Create dashboard
Create dashboard pop-up with name and description empty
Create pop-up with Asset Storage and Private viewers or editors
Empty two-column work area with Add a Gadget sidebar (31)
steal: Empty-column placeholders say Drag a gadget or add a new gadget, so the first paint after create is clear (screen 4).
A gadget library offers search, category counts (All, Jira, Charts, Wallboard), and Add per item (screen 4).
An edit-mode banner says changes are saved automatically and offers Done, so layout editing stays low-risk (screen 4).
avoid: Create-your-own dashboard, a 31-gadget library, and separate Viewers and Editors access rules (screens 1-4) are over-built for non-technical faculty (ages 40-60). Leadership asked for widgets, not a gadget operating system.
mobbin:e8c931f2-dc00-4c3f-9b4f-50b11564a.fit: Dashboard: counterweight to the deferred role-widget layer. Steal curated defaults and empty placeholders only. Do not ship a free-form gadget library. Reports, Debrief, and Scheduling content should be fixed cards that hand off into those modules.

mobbin:58df3be1-dd99-487a-83db-b759ced61.summary: Admin configures the Default dashboard affecting all users, opens Change layout column presets, and expands to a three-column grid with an empty gadget slot.
steps: Configure Default dashboard with Intro, Assigned to Me, Projects, and Activity
Change layout menu with five column presets
Three-column layout with empty third column placeholder
steal: An admin Default dashboard warning that changes affect all users supports org defaults without per-faculty gadget DIY (screens 1-3).
Change layout as five icon presets (1, 50-50, 33-66, 3-col, and so on) is a simple layout choice (screens 2-3).
An Assigned to Me list on the default home is an action-items card that can hand off into Debrief or grading (screen 1).
avoid: Per-gadget controls (drag, minimize, expand, refresh, and more) plus deep System admin structure (screens 1-3) is too much for faculty. Keep rearrange optional and the library tiny.
mobbin:58df3be1-dd99-487a-83db-b759ced61.fit: Dashboard: good model for admin-set role defaults (phase-2 widgets) with Assigned to Me handing off to Debrief and action items. Avoid exposing full layout machinery to faculty.
